statement: Show that $\\tan(A+B+C)=\\dfrac{\\tan A+\\tan B+\\tan C-\\tan A\\tan B\\tan C}{1-\\tan A\\tan B-\\tan B\\tan C-\\tan C\\tan A}$. Deduce that if $A+B+C=\\pi$ (and no angle equals $\\pi/2$), then $\\tan A+\\tan B+\\tan C=\\tan A\\tan B\\tan C$.
solution: Using $\\tan(A+B)=\\frac{\\tan A+\\tan B}{1-\\tan A\\tan B}$ and $\\tan((A+B)+C)=\\frac{\\tan(A+B)+\\tan C}{1-\\tan(A+B)\\tan C}$, substitute and simplify the numerator and denominator to obtain the stated formula. If $A+B+C=\\pi$ then $\\tan(A+B+C)=\\tan\\pi=0$, so the numerator of the formula must be zero, giving $\\tan A+\\tan B+\\tan C=\\tan A\\tan B\\tan C$.
hints: First combine A and B, then add C.
Set the whole tangent equal to tan(pi)=0.
